name: Transfusion swaps health percentages and floors the lower one at 40% (#2825)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Transfusion 705734 RecoveryTime 180000, RangeIndex 4 (30 yds), PowerType 1 (Rage), ManaCost 200 and a single effect 77 (SPELL_EFFECT_SCRIPT_EFFECT) with TargetA 57 (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_RAID) and base 39 -> 40. Its tooltip is 'Swap health percentages with an ally. Increases the lower health percentage of the two to 40%, if below that amount.' Spell::EffectScriptEffect is a hard-coded switch with no entry for family 26 or id 705734 and there was no spell_script_names row, so the cast moved no health at all. The two actors are given different maximum health (the ally is levelled down) so that a percentage swap is distinguishable from a flat health swap: with the caster at 100% and the ally at about 1.5%, the contract leaves the caster at 40% of ITS own maximum and the ally at 100% of ITS own maximum. The empowered -60 sec cooldown is a separate, already working path (AscensionPooledVitality.h maps 705734 to Empowerment::Transfusion) and is only guarded here through the unempowered 180 sec cooldown.

steps.label: Let level scaling and login settle
Fixture precondition: the caster is at full health
Fixture precondition: the ally is far below the 40% floor
The caster takes the ally's percentage, raised to the 40% floor
The ally takes the caster's percentage of its own maximum
Regression guard: the unempowered cooldown is 180 sec
